definitions.gloss: every one of them; without exception; utterly
definitions.explanation: Says that something applied to all members of a set, leaving none out. It is a formal, somewhat literary adverb and most often appears with negative or unfortunate outcomes — plans that all failed, opinions that all clashed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ことごとく⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Every one of the plans failed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もの⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ことごとく⟦{対立|たいりつ}する→対立する：22172_tairitsusuru⟧。
examples.english: His opinions clash with mine on every single point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作物|さくもつ}→作物：02823_sakumotsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ことごとく⟦だめ→だめ：00693_dame⟧になってしまった。
examples.english: The typhoon ruined every last crop in the field.

notes:
Formal and slightly literary; common in writing, news, and speeches, but rare in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ことごとく⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fail every time
- ことごとく⟦{反対|はんたい}する→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧: to oppose at every turn
- ことごとく⟦{裏切|うらぎ}られる→裏切る：02011_uragiru⟧: to be betrayed in every expectation
- ことごとく⟦{打|う}ち{砕|くだ}かれる→打ち砕く：30356_uchikudaku⟧: to be utterly shattered

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧: all — the neutral everyday word, with no literary flavor
- ⟦{残|のこ}ら→残る：01187_nokoru⟧ず: without leaving any behind — plainer, and used for pleasant outcomes too
- ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦{残|のこ}ら→残る：01187_nokoru⟧ず: every last one — emphatic and conversational
